firstLaunch.welcomeBody: Install AscendOS on your Home Screen so it feels like a real app — offline-ready, with push notifications and instant access.
firstLaunch.languageBody: The entire installation guide switches instantly.
firstLaunch.detectBodyAndroid: We detected Android. Follow these steps in your browser.
firstLaunch.detectBodyIos: We detected iPhone or iPad. Follow these steps in Safari.
firstLaunch.detectBodyOther: Open AscendOS in your phone browser, then follow the steps for your device.
firstLaunch.androidStep1Body: Tap the three-dot menu in the top-right corner of Chrome.
firstLaunch.androidStep2Body: Choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
firstLaunch.androidStep3Body: Confirm the name, then tap Add / Install.
firstLaunch.androidStep4Body: AscendOS now sits on your Home Screen like a native app.
firstLaunch.iosStep1Body: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
firstLaunch.iosStep2Body: Swipe the action list until you see more options.
firstLaunch.iosStep4Body: Confirm the name, then tap Add in the top-right.
firstLaunch.iosStep5Body: AscendOS now opens from your Home Screen — fullscreen, like a real app.
firstLaunch.advantagesBody: Home Screen installation unlocks the full AscendOS experience.
firstLaunch.advOfflineBody: Keep working even with poor or no connection — sync returns automatically.
firstLaunch.advPushBody: Live Coaching reminders and important updates reach you on the lock screen.
firstLaunch.advFasterBody: The app shell stays ready — open AscendOS instantly from your Home Screen.
firstLaunch.advNativeBody: Fullscreen, no browser chrome — focused leadership work.
firstLaunch.advUpdatesBody: New versions arrive quietly in the background.
firstLaunch.finishBody: Open AscendOS from your Home Screen anytime. You can reopen this guide under Profile → Help → Installation.
firstLaunch.helpBody: How to add AscendOS to your Home Screen.
firstLaunch.alreadyInstalledBody: AscendOS is already running as an installed app. You can still review the guide anytime.
